jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Location: Germany · Munich
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and feature planning, translating business objectives into actionable product initiatives and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, QA teams, and external partners to define product scope, priorities, and delivery plans.

  • Lead requirements analysis, solution design discussions, and technical feasibility assessments, ensuring product requirements are clearly defined, measurable, and implementable.

  • Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from requirements gathering and prioritization to development, testing, release, and post-launch optimization.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration among Product, Engineering, QA, UX, and Operations teams to ensure efficient product delivery and alignment with business objectives.

  • Monitor product development progress, identify delivery risks, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure products are delivered on time and with high quality.

  • Work closely with technical teams to evaluate system architecture, platform capabilities, APIs, integrations, and scalability requirements, ensuring sustainable product evolution.

  • Define product success metrics, analyze product performance and user feedback, and continuously optimize product functionality and user experience based on data-driven insights.

  • Manage product-related vendor and outsourcing activities, ensuring external resources deliver according to quality, timeline, and technical expectations.

  • Organize product releases, acceptance reviews, documentation management, and post-project retrospectives, driving continuous improvement of product and delivery processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Product Management, or related disciplines.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Product Management, or 3+ years of Product Management experience combined with substantial software development, solution architecture, or technical project management experience.

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and product delivery methodologies, including Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall frameworks.

  • Proven experience in requirements management, backlog prioritization, stakeholder management, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.

  • Solid technical understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud services, system integrations, databases, and enterprise application platforms.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions and vice versa.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and data-driven decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership abilities.

  • Demonstrated ownership mindset, execution capability, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, ACP, Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), Scrum Master (PSM), or similar certifications.

  • Experience with SaaS products, Cloud Platforms, Enterprise Software, or Digital Transformation initiatives.

  • Experience in the Renewable Energy, Energy Storage (BESS), Smart Energy, or Industrial Technology sectors.

  • Familiarity with system architecture design, API ecosystems, microservices, or cloud-native applications.

  • Experience working with global teams, distributed development organizations, or international vendors.

  • Knowledge of product analytics, user behavior analysis, and data-driven product optimization.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Panel (Remote, EU/UK)
jobs.description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

About the Role

Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll help shape how customers recruit and manage participants across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated and future research experiences.

This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners and other product teams.

You’ll own the customer and participant experiences as well as the systems behind them, helping Maze deliver a recruitment experience that is high-quality, reliable and able to scale with increasingly complex customer needs.

You’ll work on:

  • Own and evolve the roadmap for recruitment and participant management across Maze.

  • Improve participant quality by building stronger feedback loops, quality signals, filtering and experiences that reduce confusion for participants.

  • Make it easier for customers to recruit the audiences they need across different study types, including more complex enterprise use cases.

  • Use data and customer insights to understand panel performance and identify gaps in participant supply, quality and fulfillment.

  • Partner with Panel Operations to continuously improve the tools, workflows and handoffs used to fulfill recruitment requests.

  • Help evaluate and onboard new panel partners and identify where deeper integrations can improve quality, coverage or efficiency.

  • Develop smarter ways to route studies to the right participant supply based on customer and study needs.

  • Stay close to the operational side of recruitment so product decisions are grounded in how participant fulfillment actually happens.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Research Partners to understand customer needs, recruitment feasibility and opportunities to improve the recruitment experience.

  • Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment and the overall recruitment experience.

You should apply if:

  • You have experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager owning meaningful product areas from discovery through execution.

  • You’re highly autonomous and comfortable taking a problem, creating structure around it and driving it forward without waiting for perfect direction.

  • You’re a clear, structured communicator who can bring others along in how you think about a problem, recommendation or decision.

  • You’re comfortable working on products that span software, operations and external partners rather than living entirely within a single product surface.

  • You’re comfortable getting close to operational workflows and using what you learn to make better product decisions.

  • You have strong product judgment and can make thoughtful tradeoffs when there isn’t a perfect answer.

  • You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design to take products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  • You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities and technical constraints.

  • You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information and continuously learn from customers and internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Strong data fluency and experience using data to understand problems, prioritize opportunities and measure product outcomes.

  • Experience building products with a meaningful operational component.

  • Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience.

  • Experience in operations, business development or other roles that required you to work across product and business problems.

  • Experience managing stakeholders across multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience working with external partners, vendors or integrations that are critical to the customer experience.

  • Experience with user research or research participant recruitment.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here. 

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

Compensation: €113K – €133K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Billing (VAT)
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

At Perk, we believe in empowering cross-functional teams that drive exceptional results for our customers and the company. We’re transforming how work gets done by eliminating tedious manual processes in travel, spend, and events.

As a Product Manager at Perk, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation by identifying opportunities, shaping product strategy, and leading execution. You’ll work closely with customers, stakeholders, and lean product development teams to build best in class solutions for our users. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team and own the Billing product area.


Billing isn't just a back-office function for us; it's a strategic product area that directly impacts our ability to win in new markets and scale globally. Our billing platform enables finance teams to accurately analyse and forecast travel spend, the automation to streamline their accounting, and the accuracy to trust their financials. Thanks to our AI-powered invoice collection service and partner integrations, we help customers save thousands in VAT reclaims. We are on a mission to make complex financial operations feel effortless.

As the Staff Product Manager for Billing, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a product that is the financial engine of our business. You will transform complex challenges—from international tax compliance to AI-powered invoice data extraction—into a seamless, scalable, and intelligent billing platform. This is a mission-critical role where you will directly shape our commercial strategy, enhance customer trust, and build a key pillar of our competitive advantage.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Spend ecosystem

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a world class team of making bold, fast bets informed customer feedback, data, market research, and deep intuition for how AI can reshape how teams operate

  • Use customer insights with technical possibilities, crafting intuitive user experiences that simplify the user experience

  • Help millions of employees and thousands of finance teams seamlessly manage expenses, cards, and invoice processing.

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Claude and Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products.

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI research, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it creatively to Perk products

  • Empower Your Team: Lead with a servant-leadership approach help stay focused, remove distractions, and foster creativity and collaboration

What You’ll Need

  • Experience That Counts: Significant experience in a tech company, with proven capability as a Product Manager. Experience working on a Tax product is a strong plus. Bonus if you have experience in development, design, or business roles (though not a must).

  • Finance and accounting: You have a working knowledge of accounting reconciliation and finance operations.

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking, with a passion to understand the entire expense lifecycle — from the moment of spend inception through automated reconciliation to final posting in the ERP system — and the specific friction points unique to complex accounting workflows

  • Fluency in data and how to make data-driven product decisions

  • Experience evaluating product decisions and prioritization trade-offs

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence small teams of engineers & designers toward a common goal

  • Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders and large cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including equity in the company

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

  • Health perks such as private healthcare or gym allowance depending on your location

  • "Flexible compensation plan" to help you diversify and increase the net salary

  • Unforgettable Perk events including travel to one of our hubs

  • Mental health support tool for your wellbeing

  • Exponential growth opportunities

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Platform)
jobs.description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform products at Vio.

Our platform is where the economics of the marketplace get decided. Pricing, request optimization, price accuracy, supply integration, content, and the APIs we expose to partners. These systems determine which accommodations and deals a traveler sees, drive their decision-making, and shape what we earn on it. They have a direct impact on both our internal teams and end-user experience.

You will join one of our platform domains and own several of its products end to end. The portfolio is dynamic: priorities move, and the shape of what you own moves with them. That asks for range, and for someone who is comfortable in unfamiliar systems.

You will report to the Group Product Manager of your domain, and work day to day with engineers, tech leads, analysts, data scientists, and leadership, plus the commercial teams where your scope touches partners.

What you'll do

  • Own several product areas within your domain end to end - strategy, roadmap, initiatives, and metrics - aligning across the teams and stakeholders your work depends on.

  • Decide how success is measured, and ensure that the product meets its goals, both quantitative and qualitative.

  • Move the numbers that matter commercially. Platform work at Vio shows up in margin, yield and conversion, and your decisions should land there.

  • Discover opportunities, scope them, and give your squad a clear what and a why they believe.

  • Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into clearly scoped initiatives that deliver concrete outcomes.

  • Collaborate closely with other PMs, analysts, engineers, data scientists and leadership to align priorities and ensure group-level strategy is translated into impactful work.

  • Be a hands-on PM: dive into data, read documentation, QA features, and debug with engineers when needed.

  • Raise the bar on how your team develops product, not only on what it ships.

  • Use AI as a tool in your own product work, and help the group get better at it.

Who you are

  • You have 6+ years in product management, or fewer with a strong engineering or data background behind it.

  • You have owned platform or technical products where the output was a price, an offer, a ranking, a match or a data feed, rather than primarily a screen. You understand the system, not just the interface.

  • You have experience with data-driven product development and worked according to agile methodologies, with a passion for solving problems translating solutions into requirements that your team can execute.

  • You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, data models, algorithms and recommendation systems, and you hold your own with engineers on decisions that shape architecture. You do not need to write code.

  • You know how to work with data, utilise it and enable your product to produce it.

  • You know how to influence decision-making at all levels within an organisation and in a variety of contexts.

  • You have moved between product domains before and ramped fast. When you meet an unfamiliar problem you ask better questions than you give answers.

  • You always strive for clarity and transparency -an excellent communicator that can effectively collaborate both with engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have: a scientific or engineering degree, though quantitative role experience counts equally; experience in marketplaces, adtech, game tech or travel; two-sided marketplace economics, balancing traveler needs against partner and supply constraints.

Why join us now?

  • We're one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We're a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits - including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You'll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam.

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office.

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Although this role can be remote, we are only considering candidates based in CET +/-3 timezones to optimise team and work alignment.

Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Senior Producer (Automotive)
jobs.description:
INDG has spent 20+ years building the technology and visual production systems behind high-fidelity digital product experiences. In automotive , that means turning vehicles, trims, materials, accessories and market variants into production-grade CG assets, animations and interactive experiences used across global channels.

As Senior Producer, you own complex digital productions from first scope to final delivery. You connect client ambition with the reality of rendering pipelines, asset dependencies, review cycles, budgets, stakeholder approvals and platform constraints. You understand that a configurator, launch asset set or digital twin program is not just a creative deliverable. It is a system that has to scale across brands, markets, products and time.

You will lead work for respected global automotive where visual accuracy matters: paint response, material fidelity, lighting consistency, trim logic, camera behavior, motion, interaction and brand compliance. Your job is to bring structure to that complexity, keep teams aligned and make sure the work leaving INDG meets the visual benchmark our clients expect.

What You Will Do

1. Own complex automotive productions

Own multiple automotive projects from kick-off through delivery, including CG imagery, 3D/2D animation, configurators, digital product experiences, AR/VR, platform content and launch asset programs.

Define scopes, milestones, budgets, delivery plans and production models that match the client need and the real complexity of the work. You will identify dependencies early, from CAD readiness and material data to render capacity, localization, integration timelines and stakeholder approvals.

You will keep projects moving without reducing production to status tracking. You create the operating rhythm, surface trade-offs, drive decisions and make sure the team knows what must be solved next.

2. Translate creative intent into executable pipelines

Work with CG supervisors, artists, designers, developers, pipeline teams, project managers, vendors and client stakeholders to turn requirements into production systems that can ship.

You will help structure workflows for vehicle variants, colorways, materials, accessories, camera sets, animations and interactive behaviors. You understand that a small change in product logic can affect rendering, QA, asset naming, platform delivery and market rollout.

You do not need to be the artist or engineer in the room, but you need enough visual and technical fluency to ask the right questions, challenge vague feedback and recognize when output is not meeting the bar.

3. Lead clients, stakeholders and delivery decisions

Act as a senior client partner across global automotive accounts. Lead meetings, reviews, presentations and escalation conversations with clarity and control.

You will manage demanding stakeholder environments where brand teams, product teams, agencies, developers, local markets and vendors all have input. You keep scope, timing, quality and commercial reality visible, and you offer scenarios when priorities shift.

The role requires confidence without theater. You can explain why a render batch needs another pass, why a feature request changes the plan, or why a review process is slowing delivery.

4. Raise the standard of production

Improve how the automotive vertical plans, tracks, reviews and delivers complex digital work. Strengthen documentation, handovers, feedback loops, tooling, vendor coordination and review discipline.

You will guide project managers and coordinators, support multidisciplinary teams and help build repeatable ways of working. The goal is not one successful delivery. The goal is a production model that can support thousands of high-quality assets and digital experiences across long-term client relationships.


You operate where automotive enthusiasm, digital production discipline and visual quality meet. You can talk to a client about launch timing, a CG supervisor about render quality, a developer about configurator logic and a project manager about budget exposure without losing the thread.

You Have

  • 5+ years in digital production, CG, VFX, animation, interactive, software or platform delivery environments, with ownership of complex multidisciplinary projects.

  • Experience managing CGI-related work and a solid understanding of how CG assets move through production, review, rendering, post-production, QA and delivery.

  • Experience with interactive or digital experiences such as configurators, online product platforms, AR/VR, mobile applications or digital product experiences.

  • Strong client management experience with international brands, distributed teams, external vendors, agencies and production partners.

  • Commercial awareness across scopes, estimates, resource planning, budgets, hours, change requests and delivery risk.

  • A clear affinity with automotive, motorbikes or product worlds where engineering, design and visual identity matter.

You Think

  • Systems first. You look for repeatable workflows, clear ownership and fewer hidden dependencies.

  • Quality first, but not abstractly. You can look at a render and question lighting, material response, reflections, camera framing, compositing or product accuracy.

  • Reality first. You prefer a working production plan over a polished presentation, and you know when to push, simplify or escalate.

Your Skills Are

  • Production leadership, stakeholder management, CG pipeline fluency, interactive delivery, budget control, scope management, vendor coordination, risk tracking, review facilitation, presentation, documentation and clear English communication.

Why Join INDG

INDG sits between CGI craft, production technology and enterprise-scale content operations. Grip, our content orchestration platform, supports AI workflows and production-grade output for brands that depend on visual consistency across markets and channels.

This role matters because automotive visual production is becoming more systemized, more automated and more demanding. You will help lead the teams and client relationships that define how vehicles are represented digitally at global scale.

jobs.title: Light Delivery Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Lead the development of the beam transport and final focusing technology that delivers laser light to the target for inertial confinement fusion (ICF) at Focused Energy.

This is an early-stage technology leadership role: you'll develop key requirements, concepts and technical solutions. You'll lead the work from an unresolved engineering problem to tested concepts and a baseline design, balancing optical performance, large-optic constraints and the radiation environment near the target.

You'll build a technology strategy for the next three to five years, making decisions about R&D, space, budget and potential partners before every answer is available. Strong technical judgement and first-principles thinking matter more than having already built an identical system.

Relevant experience may include laser systems, large-optic development, aerospace, telescope optics, or directed-energy applications. Prior experience with this specific problem is not required; we value strong technical judgment and the ability to develop innovative solutions in new fields.

 

What You'll Do

• Own the technology development for beam transport and the final focusing assembly, working with systems engineering on requirements and interfaces.

• Develop and compare concepts for transporting and focusing high-energy laser beams, including maintaining wavefront quality across large optics and addressing radiation exposure at the final optic.

• Turn open technical questions into a structured R&D programme: test competing concepts, gather evidence quickly and retire options that do not meet the requirements.

• Establish a baseline concept that enables wider system and facility planning, including the space needed for the final focusing assembly. Make assumptions and trade-offs explicit, and own decisions as evidence evolves.

• Build a multi-year technology roadmap, balancing new development with available technology and planning the resources needed to deliver it.

• Lead technical specialists, set direction and responsibilities, and build the foundation for the team as the work develops.

• Decide whether beam transport should be developed internally or sourced externally. If outsourced, establish the appropriate partnership or contract and manage the technical relationship.

• Communicate risks, decisions and progress clearly to cross-functional colleagues and executive leadership.

 

Who You Are

•A strong technical foundation in high-energy laser systems or relevant large-optic technologies, sufficient to lead concept development and evaluate technical risks. Experience with small-beam high-power systems alone does not address the full challenge of this role.

• Evidence of solving unfamiliar technical problems through first-principles reasoning, experimentation and iterative concept development.

• Experience leading technical teams, setting direction, resolving disagreements and creating ownership and accountability.

• The ability to make consequential decisions with incomplete information, explain the trade-offs and take responsibility for the outcome.

• Experience building a multi-year technology strategy rather than focusing only on the next project milestone.

• The ability to work across engineering disciplines, listen to specialists and communicate clearly with VP- and C-level stakeholders.

• Comfort working through evolving requirements and extended periods of uncertainty without losing direction.

 

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Role: What to expect

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

jobs.title: Scrum Master / Delivery Enabler (m/w/d) - KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
jobs.description:
Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! 

Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.

In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.


Du hast Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Du bist aber noch unsicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Dann gibt es nur einen Weg: einfach bewerben! Nur so haben wir gemeinsam die Chance herauszufinden, ob es jetzt passt.

jobs.title: Freelance Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Beschreibung

Das Projekt

Die Naturida GmbH ist ein wachsendes, international tätiges D2C-Unternehmen mit mehreren Marken. Wir suchen eine:n erfahrene:n Freelance Product Manager:in, die/der unser Produktportfolio steuert, vor allem für unsere Beauty-Marke Bionera, und Produkte über alle Naturida-Marken hinweg von der Idee bis zum Launch und darüber hinaus verantwortet.

Eckdaten

  • Start: ab sofort
  • Laufzeit: 6–12 Monate, Verlängerung möglich
  • Umfang: 20–25 h/Woche
  • Ort: Berlin / Schönefeld bevorzugt, remote möglich (1–2 Termine vor Ort pro Monat)


Deine Aufgaben

  • Die Bionera-Produktroadmap verantworten und priorisieren: Welche Kategorien und Formate bringen wir als Nächstes?
  • Neue Produkte steuern, von Trend- und Marktrecherche über Konzept und Business Case bis zum Launch
  • Labore und Lohnhersteller briefen, steuern und Angebote verhandeln
  • Bestehende Produkte aller Naturida-Marken anhand von Reviews, Verkaufsdaten und Margen weiterentwickeln: Formel, Packaging und Claims verbessern, COGS senken, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren
  • Compliance (Safety Assessment, PIF, CPNP, Claims) mit unseren Partnern koordinieren
  • Schnittstelle zu Marketing, Amazon und Operations: Launches planen und die Performance deiner Produkte nachhalten

This role exists because INDG’s clients are asking for more than isolated CGI assets. They need repeatable production models: one source product model, many outputs, controlled visual quality, reliable timelines, and clear communication across teams. You will help build that operating layer.

You’ll manage projects in Consumer Products or Healthcare, where product accuracy, visual consistency, compliance, and delivery discipline matter. The outcome is clear: clients receive production-grade interactive experiences and 3D content that can scale across campaigns, platforms, markets, and product lines.

What You Will Do

  • Own complex delivery from kickoff to launch
    You’ll manage multiple interactive and CGI-driven projects at the same time, from scope definition through final delivery. You’ll translate client goals into timelines, resource plans, review flows, dependencies, and delivery milestones. You’ll know when a project is blocked by missing product data, unresolved art direction, technical debt, unclear feedback, or vendor capacity.

  • Connect clients, artists, developers, and vendors
    You’ll be the operating link between client teams, CG artists, designers, developers, producers, vendors, and agencies. You’ll make sure everyone understands what is being built, what quality bar applies, what decisions are pending, and what needs to happen next.   • Build delivery systems, not one-off project plans
    You’ll improve how projects run. You’ll look for repeatable patterns in CGI, digital twin, and interactive delivery and turn them into cleaner ways of working.

  • Protect visual quality while managing constraints
    You’ll understand that delivery is not complete because the file was exported. You’ll help teams balance scope, timing, budget, technical limitations, and visual ambition without hiding tradeoffs.


Who You Are

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Are you a Software Engineer who thrives on real ownership?

At Perk, we know that we feel most fulfilled when we can own the problem and the solution. This means taking responsibility for the entire lifecycle of a feature, from being part in understanding what our customers pains are with our product team, design documents, coding to deployment, and measuring impact. You will see how your technical decisions move the needle for our customers daily.

We prioritize autonomy and pragmatism, giving you the space to solve complex problems without unnecessary friction. Engineering excellence here is measured by the reliability and simplicity of the systems you build to power a global platform.

How we work

At Perk, we believe the best work happens when great people come together in small teams, with a shared sense of purpose. You'll join a cross-functional squad where you have real ownership of a piece of Perk’s domains, a genuine say in what gets built, and the autonomy to make it happen. Each team to decide how to contribute to Perk’s company goals. We care about impact, and we trust our people to deliver it.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work and what we build. On the engineering side, it spans the whole workflow: our Notion, Jira, GitHub and Slack are AI-connected so you get up to speed fast, and day-to-day it helps with specifying features, writing and reviewing code, and automated AI PR review on every pull request. When something goes wrong in production, AI surfaces context across systems quickly. We also embrace agentic coding, using AI as an active collaborator, not just a prompt-by-prompt co-pilot.

We expect candidates to use AI tools in our coding interviews. The bar is understanding your code and owning what you produce. That reflects how we work every day.

Some examples of what it means to be a Senior at Perk

  • Shape the bigger picture. You won't just build features, you'll refine the what to build and why. At Perk, senior engineers are expected to go beyond the technical solution and focus on the problem itself. You'll contribute to your squad's quarterly goals and long-term vision alongside your Product Manager and Engineering Manager.

  • Architect for today and tomorrow. When a big change is needed in how our platform works, you'll be the one writing the design documents that lay the foundation. You'll become a guardian of your team's technical quality; spotting areas of investment, proactively managing technical debt, and making sure we don't let "busy work" crowd out the work that truly matters. At Perk, we believe in impact over effort: our customers see results, not the hours behind them. Your job is to make sure we're always investing our energy where it counts most.

  • Lead across boundaries. Your influence won't stop at your own squad. You'll communicate complex ideas across multiple teams, proactively identify who needs to be involved, and drive alignment across the broader organisation. Whether it's coordinating a cross-squad initiative, contributing to one of our engineering guilds (where engineers from different teams align on shared technical topics), or pairing with architects on solution discovery, you'll operate comfortably beyond your immediate team.

  • Raise the bar for everyone around you. Senior engineers at Perk are mentors, coaches, and bar raisers. You'll support less experienced colleagues through direct mentorship, thoughtful feedback during reviews, and by modelling what great engineering looks like in practice. You'll help Engineering Managers understand where the team needs to grow technically, and you'll use spaces like guild meetings, design doc reviews, and pairing sessions to lift the overall standard. At Perk, we are a team, the team's success is your success.

Desired skills and experience

  • Product Leadership: Translates complex business goals into technical roadmaps; de-risks ambiguous projects through spikes and prototyping.

  • System Architecture: Architects scalable, evolvable systems and data models that account for performance, failure isolation, and long-term maintenance.

  • Technical Standards: Defines and upholds engineering excellence, including CI/CD optimizations, testing strategies, and coding standards across the stack.

  • Frontend Strategy: Establishes frontend architecture patterns, including state management, performance budgets, and comprehensive testing (e.g., E2E/Cypress).

  • Backend Excellence: Engineers sophisticated backend solutions involving API versioning, caching strategies, and complex data migration plans.

  • Operational Maturity: Leads observability and SRE practices; defines SLOs, manages incident responses, and conducts blameless post-mortems.

  • Security & Risk: Oversees operational security, including secrets hygiene and dependency risk management, to ensure a hardened production environment.

  • Mentorship & Influence: Levels up the engineering organization through active mentorship, leading design reviews, and influencing the product roadmap with technical data.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Coordinates multi-team deliverables and aligns stakeholders to resolve technical blockers across the organization.

  • AI-Driven Development: Experience with—or a strong interest in—modern AI-augmented workflows. This includes leveraging agentic workflows, developing custom agentic skills to extend AI capabilities, utilizing AI-powered code reviews...

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

You plan ahead. Problems get found while they are still cheap, and everything that has to land together lands together: builds, assets, store material, localization, press dates.

You lead the team's delivery. People know the plan is real, feel good about hitting it, and are still standing when it ships. The leads lead their crafts. You lead how it all comes together, and you meet each team where it is: some want you in the weeds with them on estimates and sequencing, others mainly need the picture across teams kept current. You read which is which.

We have a production pipeline that works, and like any pipeline it can always be better. You would inherit it as it is, get to know it and the people who run it, and then improve it where you see the need. Nobody here expects you to arrive with all the answers. We do hope you arrive curious about how we work and comfortable telling us, kindly and clearly, where we could do better.


What you will own

  • Production priorities day to day: the order of work across the studio, the trade-off calls within a milestone, and every open question that is blocking someone. You find who can answer, get it answered or escalated with a clear recommendation attached, and close the loop with the teams waiting on it. If a question is blocking someone, it is yours until it is not

  • Keeping design, art, engineering, QA and marketing in step with each other, week by week, so nobody is working against a version of the plan that has moved

  • The forward view: every feature in flight, what each one is still waiting on, the handoffs between departments caught early, and risk seen while it is still cheap, named, and carrying a mitigation before it turns into a schedule event

  • The team's delivery health: sustainable pace, morale, and delivery on target, treated as one problem rather than a trade-off

  • Marketing as a real production dependency, and the alignment dates around release: builds, assets, store material, localization drops, press dates, landing on time and together

  • The production plan behind all of it: a milestone schedule with a baseline, a forecast per milestone from velocity against remaining scope, estimates held against actuals, and replanning on a cycle rather than after something breaks

  • QA in step with everyone else. Our QA lead owns testing; you make sure QA knows what is coming and when, that testable builds land when the plan says they do, and that the QA window sits in the schedule where it belongs rather than where it ends up

  • External production partners: localization, video, 3D, anything we outsource. You own the relationship and the communication in both directions, and you chase. Briefs and context going out, deliveries coming in and landing in the build, and the schedule that keeps them in step with everyone else. Leads should never have to chase a partner themselves. The craft stays with the partner; making it fit is on you

  • The production process itself and the tools it runs through. We use Jira, including Jira Plans for planning months out against a baseline, and you own it for the studio. You also support hiring managers through their recruitment processes, so a lead who is hiring can focus on assessing the person rather than running the process


You

Most people who can do this job have around five years in games production behind them. Take that as a description of who tends to apply, not a bar we hold. If you can show us the things below with less, please apply anyway. We would rather meet you than miss you.

  • You know how games get made across disciplines: what waits on what, how long things really take, and where a plan is optimistic before the dates say so

  • You have produced across several titles and taken at least one PC title all the way to release, including the closing stretch: feature lock, bug burn, submission, the go decision. Which store matters less than that you have been through a PC launch. Projects that were cancelled along the way still count; we know how the last few years have gone for a lot of good people

  • You have owned priorities, not just a schedule. You have made cut-or-keep calls on a shipped title and lived with them, and you can tell us about one you got wrong

  • You have worked closely with a founder, studio head or creative director, and you know how to take decisions off their plate without going around them

  • You have built and driven a schedule, and you have written down a way of working that other people picked up and used. We would love to see examples, in whatever form they exist

  • You have led a team to a target without burning it out, and the people on it would work with you again

  • You are proactive by default and you work independently. You do not wait to be asked or chased; given an assignment, you find out what it needs and finish it well without someone checking each step. That is what senior means to us

  • Leads tell you how things are really going, because you talk with them directly and they trust you with the real picture

  • You are fluent in Jira at the level of owning it for a team, Jira Plans included. It is a tool, not the job, but it is the tool we run the plan through, so we need you good with it

  • You work our day, which runs on CET; where you sit while you do is up to you. And you are comfortable working in English, written and spoken


Helpful, not required

  • Steam specifically: Steamworks, builds and depots, the store page, review and submission, and how Early Access behaves through the whole run

  • Live operations and a patch cadence

  • Working with external production partners before, on either side of the relationship

  • Time at a small studio where you were the only producer, or where the producer and product owner were the same person

  • A remote-first team


What we offer

The whole project and the authority that comes with it. Real decisions, not just a schedule to report against. Strong leads beside you rather than under you, and a Creative Director who wants to hand things over and means it. A company small enough that what you do is visible in what we ship, and people who will notice.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. Everyone here is trusted to own their part and supported when they need a hand, and we would like that to be true for you from your first week.

And we are early. Scape is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.


Practical

  • Remote. Our working day runs on CET and this role keeps it.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract.

  • Start: as soon as you can. Tell us your notice period in the application form and we will work around it.

  • Recruitment is ongoing.
