At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

What you will do:

As a Reporting Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting the Revenue team by gathering, analysing, interpreting and aligning on data to produce actionable insights. Your work will help enhance operational performance and ensure that our team delivers focused insights to our leadership and commercial teams. You’ll create reports, dashboards, and data visualisations that inform the Revenue and wider Perk Leadership Team and contribute to data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance reports and dashboards using our data visualisation tools (Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs)

  • Enable non-technical stakeholders to use Looker and other data visualisation tools

  • Collect, clean, and analyse data from multiple sources to provide insights that improve our Revenue/GTM team's performance, including deep-dive analysis on operational KPIs

  • Own data accuracy and consistency across tools, identifying inconsistencies and partnering with teams like Revenue Operations to resolve them and maintain a single source of truth

  • Support the Team Lead, Reporting Analytics in preparing performance reviews and business reports for middle and top management, and provide ad-hoc analysis for project and process improvement initiatives

  • Use AI tools to accelerate data cleaning, report generation, and insight summarisation, freeing up time for deeper analysis

What You Will Need:

  • Multiple years of experience in a Reporting Analyst or Data Analyst role, preferably in a commercial team.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and concisely.

  • Proficiency in business intelligence and data visualisation tools (ideally Looker).

  • Familiarity with databases and querying languages (e.g., SQL).

  • High attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis, documentation, processes and reporting workflows.

This is an initial 6-month FTC position

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Lead Credit Ops
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

  • Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

  • Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Hippolyte (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

Wil jij jouw vindingrijke expertise inzetten voor de overgang van traditionele cloud naar autonome AI-platformen? Ben je ambitieus, bezit je ijzersterke analyserende skills en wil je de onmisbare fundering leggen waar ons AI- en data-team opbouwt? En heb je graag veel vrijheid in je werk? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur

We staan aan de vooravond van een enorme technologische versnelling en zetten vol in op onze 'agentic bet'. Als Senior Agentic Platform Engineer bouw jij de cruciale infrastructuur (het substraat) waarop onze Senior AI Engineers en Data Scientists hun productie-agents bouwen. Dit is geen code-generatieprobleem dat we aan AI kunnen overlaten; het is een hoogwaardig architecturaal vraagstuk. Jij bepaalt wat 'goed' betekent voor een agent in productie.

Wat betekent dit precies?

  • Eigenaarschap van de core AI-infra: In deze rol ben je de eigenaar van de evaluation harness, agent tracing, de prompt- en tool-registry (waaronder het MCP-protocol) en de routing layer voor model calls.

  • Transformatie naar SaaS: Daarnaast transformeer je onze DevOps-omgeving naar een modern SaaS-landschap waarin agent observability, model gateways en agent-aware deploy patterns de standaard zijn.

  • Modernisering & DevOps: Naast deze innovatieve AI-infrastructuur neem je de lead in het moderniseren en onderhouden van onze huidige pipelines en core DevOps-taken.

  • Tech-lead rol: Je bent een echte tech-lead van de executie en communicatie: je stemt soepel af met de andere senior developers en zet complexe uitdagingen om in heldere sprints.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

Wie is 12Build?

Met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness bouwen we aan een transparante bouwsector. We zijn niet alleen een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en samenwerking bevordert, we zijn ook marktleider in Nederland. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en we groeien nog steeds. Ons team bestaat nu uit meer dan 90 collega's, die samenwerken vanuit twee kantoren en verschillende thuiskantoren in heel Europa. Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software dagelijks. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren!

Onze tools

In ons development team zijn we continu bezig om ons SaaS-platform uit te breiden en te transformeren met de nieuwste AI- en cloudtechnologieën. Wij werken onder andere met:

  • AI & Agentic Infrastructure: Claude, AWS

  • AWS Cloud Services: SNS, SQS, S3, Lambda, RDS, EC2, ECS en API Gateway.

  • CI/CD & Automatisering: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform en OpenApi.

  • Data & Core Tech: MySQL, OpenSearch, PHP (Laravel), Vue.js (Nuxt/Vuetify) en Node (pnpm/Yarn).

  • Collaboration: Linear, Confluence, Slack en LaunchDarkly.


Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Een ervaren engineer met een duidelijke technische visie op AI binnen DevOps en de capaciteit om een sterke teamdynamiek te bevorderen.

  • Diepgaande ervaring met AWS, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker en Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Wat bieden wij je?

jobs.title: Light Generation Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As a Technical Lead – Light Generation (f/m/d) lead the development of Focused Energy's laser front-end technology, turning existing R&D and hardware into a documented, industrially deliverable system for inertial confinement fusion (ICF).

This is a technical leadership and technology ownership role, not a requirement to be the team's deepest laser specialist. You'll set direction, lead technical experts and manage suppliers as the front end moves from internal development towards outsourced manufacturing. You'll connect decisions made today to a technology roadmap spanning the next three to five years.

You won't start from a blank page: hardware and development work are already in place. The next step is to establish traceable requirements, structured documentation and approved design reviews, while building the supplier relationships and delivery plans needed to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own and develop the front-end technology so it meets the interface requirements defined by systems engineering. Work closely with the front-end subsystem and light-conditioning leads where their responsibilities overlap.

  • Take ownership of the technology roadmap, developing the existing outline into a detailed plan that connects successive projects to long-term goals.

  • Lead the technical team, establish clear responsibilities and accountability, and build the expertise needed as the group grows.

  • Manage external development and manufacturing partners, retaining strong internal technical expertise while suppliers deliver the work.

  • Develop the supplier strategy, including potential second sources, framework contracts, intellectual property arrangements and exclusivity considerations.

  • Turn existing research and hardware into an industrial engineering baseline with traceable requirements, documentation, design reviews and a hardware delivery plan.

  • Identify and manage technical and delivery risks, make trade-offs under uncertainty, and communicate decisions clearly to technical colleagues and executive leadership.

Who You Are

  • Experience leading technical teams: setting direction, resolving disagreements and creating ownership and accountability.

  • Experience delivering complex technology in an industrial setting, balancing timing, resources, documentation and technical performance.

  • Experience managing technical suppliers or development partners, including strategic and commercial discussions.

  • The ability to build a multi-year technology roadmap, not just deliver a single project with a fixed end date.

  • Enough technical understanding to engage with laser front-end specialists, evaluate their input and make informed decisions. Relevant topics include temporal contrast, spectral bandwidth and pulse shaping for ICF; deep expertise in every topic is not required.

  • Comfort making and owning decisions while requirements and priorities are still evolving, including when important questions remain unresolved for several months.

  • Clear communication with technical experts and VP- and C-level stakeholders, including the ability to listen to specialists without needing to be the expert in every discussion

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

HEY THERE!

You've designed onboarding and retention flows for a mobile app, and you care as much about what the test results tell you as you do about how the screens look. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer for our Growth squad, the team behind someone's first moments with Yazio and the first week that can determine whether they stick around.

You'll own the design process end to end, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution to shipping and testing the final UI. There's plenty of room to bring your own ideas to the table and influence what we build.

You'll work closely with our Lead PM on what to build and why. Asking questions, challenging the brief and speaking up when you think something won't work is part of the job.

You won't be designing alone. In the squad, you'll work alongside another product designer and a motion designer, sharing work and stepping into each other's projects when needed. You're also part of Yazio's wider design team, where work gets shared and critiqued openly.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

 

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

 

YOUR MISSION

Growth runs a steady stream of onboarding and retention experiments. As the designer on the squad, you’ll help shape what we test, how we design it and what we learn from the results.

  • Own product design for Growth from discovery through launch: exploring problems, prototyping, designing polished UI in Figma, handing it over to engineering and iterating once it’s live

  • Turn experiment hypotheses into thoughtful designs, then look at the A/B test results with your PM, engineers and Growth Analytics to decide what to do next

  • Improve onboarding by understanding where and why people drop off, while protecting the parts of the experience that already work well

  • Shape the first week in the app, including the gamification features that give people a reason to come back

  • Work with your PM to make sense of competing opportunities and focus the squad on the ones with the biggest potential to improve retention

  • Keep the design quality high and the experience consistent with our design system while moving quickly, with regular feedback and collaboration across the wider design team

YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You’ve designed consumer mobile apps with a freemium or subscription model and understand how activation, conversion and retention influence each other

  • You’ve worked on onboarding or retention and can show us what you shipped, how you approached the problem, the decisions you made and what you learned from the results

  • You’re comfortable setting up A/B tests, digging into the results yourself and using what you learn to change the design

  • You’re highly skilled in Figma, from prototyping and components to working with design systems, and you care about the details of interaction and visual design on a small screen

  • You like getting to the heart of a problem rather than waiting for a brief. You form a point of view, test your assumptions and bring ideas to the team

  • You’re comfortable challenging ideas when you have a reason to, and you’re equally open to having your own work challenged by other designers

  • You use AI tools as part of your design process to explore ideas, prototype and draft copy faster, while keeping a critical eye on what’s actually good enough to ship

Bonus points for:

  • Experience personalizing flows for different user segments

  • Running lightweight user research or competitor research

  • Facilitating ideation sessions with PMs and engineers

 

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change—short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections—from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being—supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Our culture

At Synthesia we're passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

The hiring process:

  • 30 min call with our Technical Recruiter

  • 45 min call with the Head of Website about your past projects

  • 75 min practical exercise with one of our engineers. We hand you a real Figma section spec and work through how you'd model and build it. Collaborative, not Leetcode.

  • 60 min call with leadership, focused on examples of collaboration, growth, and the details of your future team.

Other important info:

  • Our preference is for this role to be based either in-office or remote in London, UK. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

  • This is full-time employment only, usually through OysterHR. No contractors possible.

jobs.title: Senior Line Lead Noten
jobs.description:
Je brengt rust, geeft richting en weet hoe je een team in beweging krijgt. Op onze locatie in Doetinchem geef je leiding aan de teams Noten Verpakken en Noten Processing: samen zo’n 60 collega’s die dagelijks werken aan de lekkerste (borrel)noten. Een dynamische productieomgeving waarin prestaties, continu verbeteren en werkplezier hand in hand gaan.

In Doetinchem produceren we daarnaast meer dan 75 soorten pindakaas. Grote kans dus dat je iets van ons in huis hebt. Onze dagelijkse uitdaging is om supermarkten steeds van de juiste voorraden te voorzien. Dat vraagt om een productieorganisatie die elke dag scherp is, vooruitkijkt en samen blijft verbeteren. De operatie bestaat uit twee fabrieken en vier lijnstructuren. Als Senior Line Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor Noten Verpakken en Noten Processing. Je werkt nauw samen met de Line Leads van beide teams en zorgt samen met hen voor een optimale output van de notenfabriek. Onze operatie draait in 3 ploegen, zelf werk je in dagdienst.

Onze ambitie is helder: een factory of the future met 100% betrokkenheid van alle collega’s en nul verliezen. Een omgeving waarin iedereen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zijn of haar deel van het proces. Met IWS (Integrated Work System) als onze verbetermethodiek werken we stap voor stap aan die ambitie.

Wat ga je doen?

Je geeft leiding in een productieomgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Juist daar zorg jij voor overzicht, duidelijke prioriteiten en een werksfeer waarin collega’s zich gezien en gehoord voelen. Je neemt de leiding wanneer dat nodig is, maar geeft je teams vooral de ruimte om zelf verantwoordelijkheid te pakken, beslissingen te nemen en initiatief te tonen.

Samen met de lijnteams werk je continu aan betere prestaties. Je begeleidt de organisatie door de verschillende IWS-fasen en geeft richting tijdens de dagelijkse DDS-overleggen (Daily Direction Setting). Als ambassadeur van IWS help je collega’s begrijpen hoe continu verbeteren onderdeel wordt van het dagelijkse werk.

Je draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de resultaten van jouw productiegebied over de volledige operatie. Je bent daarom veel op de werkvloer te vinden. Daar ondersteun en ontwikkel je collega’s, zie je waar processen beter kunnen en zorg je dat verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Je analyseert onder andere verbruik, doorlooptijden, afwijkingen en andere procesvariabelen en gebruikt systemen als ERP, FMES en Ultimo om prestaties inzichtelijk te maken. Daarnaast neem je deel aan projecten en werk je intensief samen met onder andere Technische Dienst, Quality Control en Technologie aan procesanalyses en verbeteringen.

Je rapporteert aan de Plant Manager.

Wat bieden we jou?

Je krijgt een stevige leidinggevende rol binnen een productieomgeving waarin volop wordt geïnvesteerd in mensen, processen en technologie. Daarbij werk je samen met gedreven collega’s die er iedere dag iets beter van willen maken. Je krijgt:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €5.640 - €8.450 op basis van 40 uur, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Een jaarcontract voor 36-40 uur per week, met de intentie om dit daarna om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 3 ADV-dagen per jaar (op fulltime basis);

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij wij twee derde van de premie betalen;

  • Een personeelswinkel met aantrekkelijke kortingen;

  • Vier keer per jaar een goedgevuld snackpakket;

  • Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale productieorganisatie.

Jouw ingrediënten

Je hebt ervaring in een leidinggevende functie binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in food, en beschikt over een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je begrijpt hoe productie- en logistieke processen werken en hebt kennis van hygiëne-, kwaliteits- en health & safety-systemen en voorschriften. Ervaring met continu verbeteren is belangrijk; kennis van IWS of vergelijkbare verbetermethodieken is mooi meegenomen. Je bent analytisch, houdt overzicht wanneer de druk toeneemt en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Daarbij combineer je duidelijk leiderschap met aandacht voor de ontwikkeling van je team. Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels goed.

Wie zijn wij?

Intersnack is een van de toonaangevende snackproducenten van Europa. We produceren bekende merken en private label-producten die je terugvindt in vrijwel iedere supermarkt. Bij ons staat ondernemend handelen centraal. Je krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verbeteringen door te voeren en verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Tegelijkertijd doen we het samen. De sfeer is nuchter en professioneel, de lijnen zijn kort en collega’s helpen elkaar wanneer dat nodig is. Samen groeien en verantwoord denken zijn belangrijke onderdelen van onze cultuur. We combineren de kennis en ervaring van onze teams met individueel eigenaarschap en blijven investeren in innovatie, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en efficiëntere productie.


Zie jij jezelf leidinggeven aan twee belangrijke teams binnen onze notenfabriek en samen met hen bouwen aan de productieomgeving van de toekomst? Solliciteer dan op de functie van Senior Line Lead.

Heb je eerst nog vragen? Bel of WhatsApp dan met Iris op 06-10114611 .

jobs.description:
Overview

The Executive Assistant is a highly organised, proactive and collaborative partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team. Combining high-quality executive support with seamless coordination, this role sits at the heart of the business and offers unique exposure to strategic decision-making across a fast-growing, international company. You’ll bring structure to a fast-moving environment, balancing effective forward planning with practical, methodical and hands-on execution. Beyond day-to-day support, you’ll have the opportunity to improve executive processes, coordinate high-impact company initiatives and help the leadership team operate at its best.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Partnership

  • Partner closely with the CEO to manage priorities, schedules, and day-to-day operations.

  • Own the CEO's calendar and travel, resolving diary conflicts against agreed priorities.

  • Prepare agendas, presentations, briefing documents, and meeting materials.

  • Communicate and work with external parties, including customers, the company board, and potential future investors.

Executive Operations

  • Coordinate the operating rhythm of the Executive Leadership Team.

  • Organise leadership meetings, planning sessions, quarterly offsites, and company events.

  • Capture decisions, maintain action logs, and follow up with owners until actions are closed.

  • Review the leadership meeting calendar each quarter and recommend where meetings or reports can be consolidated or dropped.

  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve efficiency, check for accuracy, and advocate for their use to streamline internal processes.

Company Operations

  • Work with the CFO and relevant parties to own the companywide communications for Goals, including clear updates, robust practices and effective measurement and reporting.

  • Support the CRO in establishing and maintaining an effective operating cadence, including coordinating GTM leadership meetings, cross-functional sessions and team events.

  • Partner with the People Team to deliver key projects and initiatives that contribute to the company’s success, including supporting company-wide meetings and All Hands.

  • Use company knowledge to identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, escalating where appropriate.

Key Competency Behaviours & Ways of Working

Impact & Ownership - delivers high-impact work and takes accountability for outcomes

  • Ownership and follow-through: takes end-to-end accountability for outcomes rather than tasks, closing loops without needing to be chased.

  • Executive judgement: prioritises well on the CEO's behalf on day-to-day matters, and knows what to handle independently and what to escalate.

  • Anticipates rather than reacts: surfaces decisions, risks, and dependencies before they become urgent.

  • Delivers to deadline: flags slippage early rather than absorbing it silently.

Growth & Innovation - brings game-changing solutions that drive growth

  • Continuous improvement: actively simplifies processes and adopts better tooling, including AI, to increase leadership leverage.

  • Commercial awareness: understands the business model and company priorities well enough to sequence competing demands sensibly and flag when something important is at risk.

  • Structure in ambiguity: turns vague requests into clear plans, checklists and timelines for the work they are coordinating.

Team & Collaboration - works effectively and constructively toward collective goals

  • Influence without authority: secures commitment from senior stakeholders and follows up on outstanding actions without relying on positional authority.

  • Communicates concisely and in writing, leading with a recommendation rather than an open question.

  • Manages upwards with confidence, raising issues and blockers directly with senior leaders.

  • Discretion and trust: handles sensitive information and difficult conversations with complete confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like

  • Schedules are planned in advance, with conflicts resolved proactively and without requiring their involvement.

  • Leadership meetings are supported by clear agendas circulated in advance, with actions assigned, documented and completed by agreed deadlines.

  • Project progress, ownership and risks are kept up to date and readily visible to the Leadership Team.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Enterprise Account Executive to join Aibidia’s London team and play a key role in accelerating our growth across the UK and Europe.

This is a high-impact, new business role for an enterprise seller who knows how to navigate complex organisations, engage senior Finance and Tax leaders, and build momentum across multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

  1. Initial conversation with Elena.

  2. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager.

  3. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA.

  4. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric.

  5. Strategic interview with Raph.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Ecochain is a fast-growing, purpose-driven B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to make sustainability data accessible for 100M products by 2035. We build LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) automation platforms—Mobius and Helix—that help Industrial Manufacturers quantify, share, and reduce their environmental footprint with speed and scale.

Founded in 2011 in the Netherlands, we're now a team of 50+ professionals serving Construction Products and Industrial Equipment manufacturers across Benelux, DACH, and beyond. Our customers trust us to turn complex impact data into actionable insights, enabling them to meet compliance requirements (CPR, EPBD, ESPR) and build more sustainable products.

Our Values:

  • We Care – We support our teammates, customers, and the planet

  • We Share – We grow stronger by sharing knowledge, feedback, and success

  • We Empower – We create space for people to lead, learn, and make a difference

The Role

As our Senior Financial Operations Specialist, you'll own the operational backbone of our financial administration—accounts receivable, the vendor invoice pipeline, and a clean, on-time month-end close. Reporting directly to our Financial Controller, you won't be assisting someone else's process. You'll own a domain outright, and your Controller will review your work rather than rebuild it.

This is a deliberately designed 24-hour role. Not a full-time job squeezed into part-time pay, and not a stopgap—a permanent, well-organised position for someone who wants to do one thing properly rather than five things partially.

What You'll Do

  • Own accounts receivable end-to-end—customer billing, contract invoicing, credit management, and the AR aging overview.

  • Run collections independently, following up past-due balances with a friendly, professional approach and resolving billing queries yourself.

  • Manage the accounts payable pipeline—intake, approval routing, and submission of vendor invoices to our external accountant.

  • Prepare weekly payment batches for approval, maintaining continuous oversight of what's unpaid.

  • Code invoices accurately to the correct general ledger accounts and cost centres.

  • Prepare routine monthly journal entries (accruals and revenue allocations) and perform balance-sheet reconciliations.

  • Review P&L cost and revenue lines to verify correct period allocation.

  • Keep the administration audit-ready as a matter of course, and support the Financial Controller on ad-hoc projects and process improvements.

  • Reports to: Financial Controller

  • Team: Finance (working closely with our external accountant, Customer Success, and Sales)

  • Hours: 24 per week—three full days, or spread across four or five. You choose the pattern.

What We Offer

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Gross full-time salary of €3,500 – €4,500 per month depending on experience (based on 40 hours, pro-rated to 24 hours), plus 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld)

  • Secondary benefits: Pension contribution, phone allowance, sports allowance

  • Free lunch options in our Amsterdam-area office

  • 100% public transport reimbursement or €0.25/km for own vehicle

Purpose & Impact

  • Mission-driven work: Enable 100M products to share sustainability data by 2035

  • Real-world impact: Clean, well-run administration is what frees up capacity for the mission-driven work everyone else here is doing. Cash collected on time is cash that funds the next release

  • B Corp employer: We're measured on our impact, not just our margins

Growth & Development

  • Scale-up phase: We're growing—be part of the journey

  • High ownership: Influence how our financial processes are designed, not just how they're executed

  • Career path: Grow through scope—ownership of the close calendar, the AP approval design, supplier terms. If the role outgrows 24 hours, we'll have that conversation honestly

  • Learning culture: Product training, cross-functional exposure, and sustainability context you won't get in a traditional finance department

Work-Life Integration

  • Genuinely flexible hours: 24 per week, structured around your life. We plan around your pattern, not the other way around

  • Hybrid working: Office presence during close week, otherwise your call

  • Protected time: When you're off, you're off. You are not expected to monitor emails, Slack, or check in on days you aren't working

  • Trust-based culture: High autonomy with clear accountability and support

  • Inclusive team: International team of 50+ colleagues who live our values (We Care, We Share, We Empower)

How to Apply

Submit your application including your Resume/CV and a Cover Letter. We read the cover letter first, and we'd love for you to answer three quick questions directly:

  1. The full cycle you've owned: Walk us from a customer signing to the accountant filing. Be specific about where your responsibility started and stopped.

  2. A balance you recovered: Tell us about a past-due balance you recovered from an unhappy customer. What did you say, and what happened to the relationship afterwards?

  3. Managing a 24-hour week: How do you organize your work across 24 hours so that routine deadlines (like month-end or payment runs) are met smoothly without urgent tasks getting stuck on days you're off?

Three short paragraphs are plenty. Specific beats polished—we'd rather read one real story than three pages of adjectives.

Interview Process

We move quickly for the right candidate:

  1. Screening Interview – Financial Controller (30 min): Culture fit, ownership experience, motivation, and how a 24-hour week fits your life.

  2. Working Interview – Financial Controller (90 min): A live case using real, anonymised material from our own administration, plus a short take-home assignment (capped at 3 hours, and paid).

  3. Final Interview – CEO (30 min): Vision alignment, long-term commitment.


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • Full-cycle ownership: Proven track record in bookkeeping, financial administration, or financial operations where you've owned a complete financial administration alongside an external accountant.

  • Accounting know-how: Solid understanding of general ledger mechanics, double-entry bookkeeping, accruals, and reconciliations.

  • Collections capability: You chase money by picking up the phone, and you keep the relationship intact while you do it.

  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable with cloud accounting platforms (e.g. Exact, AFAS, NetSuite) and Excel.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and Dutch, written and spoken—including phoning a customer about money in either.

  • Self-starter mentality: You manage your own schedule and follow up on details independently.

Strong Preferences:

  • Scale-up or SaaS experience—particularly recurring billing (proration, mid-term upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions)

  • Experience working alongside an external accountant rather than inside a large finance department

  • Company size of roughly 30–150 people—big enough for real volume, small enough that you owned it

  • B2B invoicing to international customers across multiple countries and currencies

  • Dutch professional qualifications (PDB, MBA Moderne Bedrijfsadministratie, MBO/HBO bedrijfsadministratie)

  • Having been through an audit or due-diligence process from the administration side

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • You've owned a complete financial administration and can describe exactly where your responsibility started and stopped

  • You take genuine pride in clean accounts—being audit-ready is just how you work, not a project you run in January

  • You treat collections as a relationship job with a number attached, not as sending reminders

  • You're clear and outcome-focused: you appreciate having simple, transparent goals so you always know what success looks like

  • You want a permanent, well-organised 24-hour role that fits your life, and you're not looking to grow out of it next year

  • You'd rather fix the cause of a recurring problem than get faster at handling it

  • You're willing to tell a colleague—including a senior one—that a number or a contract term is wrong

YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF:

  • You've only ever been one specialist inside a large finance department—this role has nobody to hand work to

  • You need fully remote work (we need you in the Amsterdam office during close week)

  • You want to move into controlling or FP&A within a year—this is a permanent operations role and that ambition will frustrate you

  • You're looking for a bonus—there isn't one here, deliberately

  • You expect a full-time workload to be squeezed into 24 hours, or you expect 24 hours to mean 32

  • You view part-time as "less accountability" rather than "same ownership, fewer hours"

About Ecochain's Culture

We're a diverse, international team committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every team member is valued for their unique perspectives. We believe in:

  • Transparency: Open communication, shared wins and mistakes, honest feedback

  • Empowerment: Trust over micromanagement, ownership over task execution

  • Care: Support for teammates, customers, and the planet—always

  • Accountability: Clear expectations, regular check-ins, and data-driven decision-making

If you're ready to combine precise, well-run financial operations with meaningful, planet-positive work, we'd love to hear from you.

Ecochain is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Operations Specialist (2)
jobs.description:
Ecochain is een snelgroeiende, purpose-driven B2B SaaS scale-up met een missie: duurzaamheidsdata toegankelijk maken voor 100 miljoen producten in 2035. We bouwen LCA-automatiseringsplatforms (Mobius en Helix) waarmee industriële fabrikanten hun milieu-impact kunnen meten, delen en verminderen.

Ons team van 50+ professionals werkt vanuit Amsterdam en bedient klanten in de bouw en maak-industrie, verspreid over de Benelux, DACH en verder. We zijn gecertificeerd B-Corp en meten onszelf op impact, niet alleen op marge.

De rol

Als Senior Financial Operations Specialist ben jij de eigenaar van onze financiële operaties: accounts receivable, de leveranciers facturen pijplijn en een schone, tijdige maandafsluiting. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan onze Financial Controller, je assisteert niemand, je bezit je eigen domein.

Dit is een rol van 24 uur per week. Geen fulltime job, maar een permanente, goed georganiseerde positie voor iemand die één ding uitstekend wil doen.

Uren: 24 per week — drie volle dagen, of verspreid over vier of vijf. Jij kiest.

Wat ga je doen

  • Accounts receivable end-to-end beheren: facturatie, creditbeheer en de AR-ouderdomsanalyse

  • Openstaande saldo's zelfstandig innen, professioneel, met behoud van de klantrelatie

  • De leveranciers facturen pijplijn beheren: intake, goedkeuringsrouting en aanlevering aan onze externe accountant

  • Wekelijkse betalingsbatches voorbereiden ter goedkeuring

  • Facturen correct boeken op grootboekrekeningen en kostenplaatsen

  • Maandelijkse journaalposten (accruals en omzetallocaties) voorbereiden en balansreconciliaties uitvoeren

  • P&L controleren op correcte periodeindeling

  • De administratie continu audit-ready houden en de Financial Controller ondersteunen bij ad-hoc projecten


Wat we zoeken

Must-haves

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met volledige financiële administratie naast een externe accountant

  • Gedegen kennis van grootboekadministratie, dubbel boekhouden, accruals en reconciliaties

  • Je int openstaande bedragen door de telefoon te pakken — en houdt de relatie intact

  • Vertrouwd met cloud-boekhoudpakketten (bijv. Exact, AFAS, NetSuite) en Excel

  • Vloeiend in Nederlands én Engels, schriftelijk en mondeling

  • Zelfstandig en proactief: je beheert je eigen agenda en volgt details op zonder aansporing

Pré

  • Ervaring in een scale-up of SaaS-omgeving, bij voorkeur met terugkerende facturatie

  • Gewerkt naast een externe accountant (niet binnen een grote finance-afdeling)

  • Bedrijfsomvang van 30–150 medewerkers

  • B2B-facturatie aan internationale klanten in meerdere valuta

  • Relevante opleiding: PDB, MBA Moderne Bedrijfsadministratie of MBO/HBO bedrijfsadministratie

Wat we bieden

  • Salaris: € 3.500 – € 4.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, pro rata naar 24 uur) + 8% vakantiegeld

  • Secondary benefits: pensioenbijdrage, telefoonvergoeding, sportvergoeding,

  • Gratis lunch in ons kantoor in de regio Amsterdam

  • 100% OV-vergoeding of € 0,25/km eigen vervoer

  • Toegang tot OpenUp

  • Flexibele werktijden: 24 uur, ingepland rond jouw leven, niet andersom

  • Hybride werken: aanwezig tijdens de maandafsluiting, verder jouw keuze

  • Werken aan echte impact: schone administratie is wat ruimte vrijmaakt voor onze duurzaamheidsmissie

Sollicitatieprocedure

Voeg bij je sollicitatie een cv en een korte motivatiebrief toe. We lezen de motivatiebrief als eerste, beantwoord daarin deze drie vragen:

  1. De volledige cyclus die jij hebt beheerd: beschrijf het traject van een klant die tekent tot de accountant die afsluit. Wees specifiek over waar jouw verantwoordelijkheid begon en eindigde.

  2. Een saldo dat je hebt geïnd: vertel over een achterstallig bedrag dat je hebt ingeïnd bij een ontevreden klant. Wat zei je, en hoe stond de relatie er daarna voor?

  3. Werken in 24 uur: hoe organiseer je je werk zodat terugkerende deadlines (zoals de maandafsluiting) soepel verlopen, ook op dagen dat je er niet bent?

Drie korte alinea's zijn genoeg. Concreet gaat boven gepolijst.

Onze procedure:

  • Screening met de Financial Controller (30 min): cultuurfit, ervaring en motivatie

  • Working interview met de Financial Controller (90 min): live case op basis van geanonimiseerd materiaal + een betaalde take-home opdracht (max. 3 uur)

  • Eindgesprek met HR en de CEO (30 min): visie en langetermijncommitment

jobs.title: Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

𝘕𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘐𝘘 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘎𝘋𝘗 𝘰𝘧 𝘌𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘱𝘦.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝘁 𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹

You sit at the operational 𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮. You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

Capital Markets

  • Own end-to-end ETF delivery across capital markets, portfolio replication and platform operations

  • Implement and continuously improve replication models; execute index rebalances and support advisory mandates

  • Own ETF quality monitoring (tracking error/difference, liquidity/spreads, premiums/discounts, order books), run root-cause analyses and implement corrective actions

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

  • Run daily validation and reconciliation of key data outputs (pricing, holdings and reference data)

Clients and Ecosystem

  • Join client demos and workshops as our capital markets expert

  • Represent NaroIQ at industry events, roundtables and conferences together with our Growth team

  • Support our Growth and Clients teams on client-specific questions

Working with Product

  • Raise requirements from daily operations and give business sign-off on what Product delivers

  • Use and stress-test the AI-driven workflows we build for ETF operations, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿

  • Experience in ETF operations, capital markets, trading, portfolio management, or fund operations

  • Strong understanding of ETF primary/secondary market mechanics

  • Comfort with operational excellence: high ownership, detail orientation and reliability in a mission-critical operating environment

  • Experience working at the intersection of finance and tech

  • Analytical strength and ability to translate domain needs into clear product requirements
