jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

As an Account Executive at Rillet, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming how high-growth companies run their finances. Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.


What You'll Do

  • Build the GTM playbook
    You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.


Who We're Looking For

  • 4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close.

  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.

  • Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.

  • Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.

  • Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: OTE $240,000 – $280,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Compensation: $240K – $280K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, Java)
jobs.description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Senior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Our Knowledge Team is the layer between the content and the AI. We pull in millions of documents from internal databases, public sources, and the web, standardize them, and make them usable for the AI agents that distill answers from them. The real challenge isn't storage but selection. Out of those millions of documents, exactly one paragraph needs to surface the moment a lawyer asks a question. Surface the wrong one, and the agent gives an answer that sounds plausible but is wrong. In our field, that's not a bug: it's a liability issue. What you build determines whether the answer holds up.

There's work to be done, and it's the kind of work you could talk about for a whole evening. The pipeline has been running for six years, built in Scala and Java, and parts of it deserve a new foundation. Reranking is the biggest need: determining which passage, out of a mountain of legal documents, actually answers the question being asked. Not just which one contains the matching words. That's the problem we’re solving. The team is strong on the scientific side, in retrieval, and in understanding what a model can and can't handle. What we're looking to add is engineering firepower: someone who can turn ideas into systems that deliver. Not to rebuild everything over six months just because it was once set up differently, but to see where the real gains are and start there.

  • You build and improve the pipeline that turns content into knowledge our AI agents can use.

  • You work on reranking quality, so the agent gets the right information, not just the most information.

  • You help shape the approach to retrieval and knowledge extraction, bringing in what you've seen work elsewhere.

  • You work in Python for everything new, and in Java where the existing codebase calls for it.

  • You make technical decisions, even when no one is looking over your shoulder.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're an engineer who looks beyond the ticket. You want to understand why something is being built and what it delivers for the customer, and you're not afraid to have an opinion about it. You don't need a manager to make a technical call, and you speak up when you think something should be done differently.

  • Experience with Python and Java. Everything newly built is developed in Python, closely aligned with the AI teams who also work in it. But a large part of our current codebase runs on Java, so you need to be comfortable working with that too.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch. That's where it's determined which information the agent gets to see.

  • Experience with Scala or Kotlin is a plus. The ingestion layer runs largely on Scala.

  • You come from SaaS, a product-driven organization, or a scale-up, and you thrive on autonomy rather than oversight.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

At Lefebvre Sdu, you'll work in an organization that's in the middle of a transformation and takes the public market seriously. That's the direction, and we're making the journey together. You'll get the mandate, the space, and the colleagues to make it happen.

You'll join a team with a Product Owner, three frontend developers, a UX designer, and a Scrum Master who also works across multiple teams. You'll have room to shape your role and help determine how we work, with a clear shared goal: building the AI-first platform. You'll bring the backend experience the team needs to take real end-to-end ownership, and you'll report to the Lead Frontend Developer. You'll take part in the team's regular scrum rituals (dailies, refinements, retros, planning) and have one-on-ones with your manager. Through the team, you'll also be an important point of contact for application administrators and customer support who need technical assistance, so you should enjoy breaking down technical problems and communicating about them with less technical colleagues.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Datenkatalog-Infrastruktur: Betrieb und Bereitstellung von OpenMetadata. Dazu gehören die Katalog-Infrastruktur und die Trennung zwischen Betrieb und Nutzung wie bei den Lake-Ebenen. Data & AI ergänzt darauf aufbauend Datensatzbeschreibungen, Glossar und Stewardship-Inhalte.

  • Tooling-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Superset, dem Werkzeug der Teams für Datenabfragen und Visualisierungen.

  • Abgrenzung der Pipelines: klare Codegrenzen, ein Merge-blockierender Vertragscheck und eine eindeutige Regel für die Weiterleitung von Vorfällen: Bei Infrastrukturproblemen wirst du benachrichtigt oder alarmiert, nicht bei Fehlern in der Pipeline-Logik.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Aufbau von Observability und operativer Exzellenz für die Data Platform, unter anderem mit Datadog, Incident Response sowie SLOs und SLIs. Du übernimmst den On-Call-Dienst; die Vergütung dafür entspricht vom ersten Tag an der Regelung anderer Teams.

  • Governance- und Compliance-Mechanismen: Die Richtlinien selbst – etwa Klassifizierungsstandards, Aufbewahrungsregeln und der Umgang mit DSGVO- und Datenschutzanfragen – werden außerhalb von SET und Data & AI durch Legal/Compliance oder eine datenschutznahe Funktion verantwortet. Du legst diese Richtlinien nicht fest, sondern implementierst die dafür erforderliche Architektur: Aufbewahrungsfristen, Zugriffskontrollen, Klassifizierungsmetadaten und die Weiterleitung von Löschanfragen.

  • Plattformübergreifende Konsistenz: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur, damit die Data Platform dieselbe Self-Service-Philosophie und denselben Reifegrad wie die übrige Plattform erreicht.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische AWS-Erfahrung mit Glue, Athena, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lake Formation und S3 sowie umfassende Terraform-Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Weiterentwickeln gemeinsam genutzter Module.

  • Praxiserfahrung mit CDC-Pipelines und einer Iceberg-basierten Lakehouse-Architektur mit den Ebenen Raw, Curated und Aggregated. Dieses Format ist heute produktiv im Einsatz.

  • Vertrautheit mit Kafka-basiertem Event-Streaming (MSK, Glue Schema Registry) für Ereignisse auf Anwendungsebene, die neben CDC-Daten in der Plattform landen.

  • Sicherheit im Betrieb einer Plattform, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind: Erfahrung mit Incident Response und SLOs sowie das Urteilsvermögen, individuelle Anforderungen in den Backlog aufzunehmen, statt sie ad hoc umzusetzen.

  • Starke teamübergreifende Kommunikation: Du arbeitest direkt mit Data & AI daran, die Grenzen zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik klar zu halten, und stimmst dich mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur zu übergreifenden Standards ab. Keine der beiden Beziehungen ist eine Berichtslinie.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis dafür, was eine datengetriebene Kultur nachhaltig verankert: Führungskräfte, die anhand von Kennzahlen handeln, organisationsweite Datenkompetenz, eine für alle Zielgruppen zugängliche Infrastruktur und Daten als gemeinschaftliche Ressource.

Nice to have:

jobs.title: Endear - Product Designer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

jobs.title: Senior Radiochemist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
  • Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
  • Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • Start date:          early 2027, and no later than April 2027
  • Location:            Vernier, GE, with monthly presence at Villigen, AG; Switzerland. This position also involves regular travels to North America.
  • Contract:            Full-time, permanent employment contract
  • Package:             We offer competitive remuneration and social security, accident/disability insurance and pension plans; one day per week work from home, as well as five weeks’ paid vacation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

One to two technical interviews with the hiring manager, HR and other Transmutex team members; interview with Management for shortlisted candidates. At least one interview will be organized on-site in Geneva.

Computer Vision & AI Engineer - Interceptor C‑UAS (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the role:

At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints.

We are looking for a Computer Vision & AI Engineer to drive the perception stack of our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation.

This role is suited for someone with a strong academic or practical background in computer vision, AI, robotics, or perception systems. A Master’s degree is expected; a PhD is a strong plus. We are open to ambitious early-career candidates if they bring strong technical depth, practical implementation skills, and the ability to own complex perception problems.

Your Mission

You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight. This includes low-latency detection and tracking, motion-aware vision, sensor fusion with inertial data, 3D direction-vector estimation, GPS-denied navigation, and precision landing support.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction.

  • Develop detection algorithms for small and difficult-to-see objects in moving and rotating camera images.

  • Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate.

  • Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve detection and tracking in moving image sequences.

  • Build object tracking pipelines that can switch from initial detection to low-latency tracking once a target has been acquired.

  • Optimize perception pipelines for embedded execution on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

  • Work toward high frame-rate processing targets in the range of 100–300 FPS, where technically feasible.

  • Use camera intrinsics and extrinsics to transform image-space detections into 3D direction vectors or other navigation-relevant outputs.

  • Work on GPS-denied navigation concepts using visual odometry, including approaches with forward-facing camera views rather than only downward-looking cameras.

  • Develop visual support for precision landing, including height estimation, velocity estimation, and motion-state estimation from limited camera perspectives.

  • Build and maintain the data pipeline from onboard recordings to cloud storage, preprocessing, annotation, dataset generation, training, validation, and benchmarking.

  • Work with annotation tools such as SuperAnnotate, CVAT, Label Studio, or comparable systems.

  • Benchmark and evaluate different model and algorithm families, including approaches such as CenterNet, SuperPoint, SuperGlue, optical flow, feature tracking, object detection, and lightweight embedded models.

  • Build deployment pipelines using ONNX, TensorRT, custom inference runners, or comparable embedded inference tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with autonomy, flight control, embedded software, test, and systems engineering teams.



What you bring to the team:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in computer vision, AI, robotics, machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals, camera geometry, feature detection, object detection, tracking, calibration, and image-space to 3D transformations.

  • Practical experience implementing computer vision or machine learning pipelines in Python and C++.

  • Experience with embedded inference, ideally on NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, GStreamer, V4L2, or similar technologies.

  • Ability to read, understand, and implement ideas from current research papers.

  • Understanding of latency, throughput, profiling, memory movement, and real-time constraints.

  • Experience with dataset creation, annotation workflows, training/validation splits, metrics, and benchmarking.

  • Strong mathematical intuition and willingness to debug both algorithms and real-world sensor data.

  • Ability to take ownership of a technical area and drive it from research prototype to flight-test-ready software.

    • Experience with UAV perception, robotics perception, visual odometry, SLAM, sensor fusion, or tracking systems.

    • Experience with IMU-camera fusion, ego-motion compensation, rolling-shutter effects, or high-frame-rate cameras.

    • Experience with precision landing, visual navigation, or GPS-denied navigation.

    • Experience building cloud-based ML training and validation pipelines.

    • Publications, thesis work, GitHub projects, demos, or competition results in computer vision, robotics, AI, or autonomous systems.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation.

  • Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact.

  • Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Au sein de l’équipe Fraude, tu contribueras à la lutte contre la fraude externe à l’échelle du Groupe, présent en France, en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et en Allemagne.
 
Tu auras pour mission d’innover en mettant l’IA et la data au service de la détection et de la prévention de la fraude, de piloter la fraude par la donnée et de construire la lutte contre la fraude sur nos nouveaux produits.
 
Tu évolueras dans une organisation tech et en croissance, où la data et la technologie sont au cœur des décisions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Data, Tech, Produit et les équipes anti-fraude locales.
 

Missions 🚀

1) Définir et faire évoluer le système de détection de fraude
    • Développer un dispositif antifraude efficace en collaboration avec les Business Units, les équipes Produit et Data, en t’inspirant des meilleures pratiques du marché
    • Concevoir des parcours modulaires adaptés au niveau de risque de fraude, en optimisant l’équilibre entre friction et prévention
    • Anticiper les risques de fraude liés au lancement des nouvelles offres bancaires et des programmes de cashback dès leur conception

2) Innover grâce à l’intelligence artificielle et à la veille technologique
    • Suivre l’évolution des menaces et des technologies de lutte contre la fraude, identifier les solutions les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations
    • Tester de nouvelles approches et piloter des POC
    • Concevoir et déployer, avec les équipes Data, Tech et Produit, des outils intelligents pour automatiser la détection et faciliter le travail des analystes

3) Piloter la performance et harmoniser les pratiques à l’échelle du Groupe
    • Construire et harmoniser les indicateurs de suivi de la fraude, développer les tableaux de bord et le reporting à destination du management
    • Analyser les tendances pour anticiper les risques et proposer des plans d’action
    • Travailler avec les équipes anti-fraude des différents pays pour partager les bonnes pratiques, contribuer à l’harmonisation des processus et suivre les évolutions réglementaires européennes et locales liées à la fraude

À propos de toi 👇

    • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce, master data, statistiques ou risques),
    • Tu justifies de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en lutte contre la fraude, gestion des risques, conformité ou data, idéalement en banque, cabinet de conseil ou fintech,
    • Tu maîtrises Excel et SQL, et tu as une bonne pratique des outils d’IA (machine learning, IA générative) et de data visualisation,
    • Tu connais bien les sujets de fraude au crédit et de  LCB-FT ; une expérience sur la fraude bancaire, aux moyens de paiement ou aux programmes de fidélité / cashback est un vrai plus,
    • Tu es curieux.se, tu as le goût de la veille et tu fais preuve de rigueur analytique,
    • Tu es autonome, de l’idée à la mise en production, et à l’aise dans un environnement international et transverse,
    • Tu parles anglais couramment, une autre langue européenne (italien, espagnol, portugais) constitue un atout.

Processus de recrutement 📅

    • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître et échanger autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min)
    • Deuxième entretien en visio avec Baptiste, Responsable Risque Opérationnel, pour revenir sur ton parcours et échanger sur ta vision de la fraude et de l’IA (30 min)
    • Étude de cas data et fraude à restituer à Baptiste suivie d’un échange avec tes futur.e.s collègues (90 min)
    • Entretien final en visio avec Romain, Group Chief Risk & Data Officer (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)
  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe
  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited
  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun
  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso
  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés
  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales
  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an
  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)
  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 
  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur
  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

jobs.description:

Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur

We rollen in hoog tempo nieuwe AI-gedreven features en agents uit. Om dit betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en meetbaar te maken, zoeken we een scherpe Site Reliability Engineer. Jij wordt de architect achter onze operationele zichtbaarheid en de drijvende kracht achter onze metrics. Waar anderen code schrijven of systemen deployen, zorg jij voor de fundamentele datalaag die bewijst dat onze systemen op het hoogste kwaliteitsniveau presteren. Je bent iemand van de executie en de communicatie; je vertaalt complexe telemetry-data naar glasheldere inzichten voor alle belanghebbenden.

Binnen ons team ga je direct impact maken met drie grote, strategische projecten:

Je definieert heldere Service Level Indicators (SLI's) en Service Level Objectives (SLO's) in Datadog voor onze kritieke endpoints (zoals API-responstijden en database-latencies). Met behulp van error budget-alerting en real-user monitoring (RUM) signaleer en elimineer je performance-bottlenecks voordat onze eindgebruikers er last van hebben.

Hiermee maken we direct inzichtelijk wat de adoptie en doorloop is vóór en na de brede uitrol van AI-tooling.

Want we willen niet alleen weten of er iets draait, maar vooral of het op het juiste kwaliteitsniveau draait.

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As our Senior Accounting Manager, you will own the technical accounting, close, and consolidation processes across Focused Energy's German and US entities. You will bring together IFRS, US GAAP, and German GAAP requirements to deliver reliable financial results as our international business grows. You will have broad ownership of accounting judgments, reconciliations, and reporting quality. You will combine hands-on delivery with process improvement, building the controls, documentation, and automation that help Finance and the wider business trust the numbers.

What You'll Do

• Own accounting across our international entities, applying IFRS, US GAAP, and German GAAP to complex accounting questions and making well-supported decisions within your remit.

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, owning close calendars, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, eliminations, and consolidation across Germany and the US.

• Deliver accurate, timely financial statements and management reporting, explaining material movements and giving Finance leadership clear insight into the results.

• Build and strengthen accounting policies, internal controls, and documentation, keeping records complete, consistent, and audit-ready as the business scales.

• Make our accounting systems work reliably together, improving data flows and reconciliations across NetSuite, NetAssets, Moss, and Ramp and resolving issues before they affect the close.

• Turn recurring accounting work into scalable processes, introducing automation and practical tools that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

• Work directly with Finance and business stakeholders, communicating accounting decisions clearly, surfacing risks early, and resolving issues independently while escalating company-wide policy and audit-strategy decisions appropriately.

 

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of professional accounting experience, including significant hands-on ownership of accounting processes in an international, multi-entity environment.

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a comparable professional qualification.

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge across German GAAP, IFRS, and US GAAP.

  • Proven experience owning monthly, quarterly, and annual close, including reconciliations, intercompany accounting, consolidation, and financial reporting.

  • Ability to make sound accounting judgments independently and distinguish between entity-level decisions and matters requiring company-wide escalation.

  • Experience designing, documenting, and improving accounting workflows, internal controls, and audit-ready records.

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP such as Oracle NetSuite, or a comparable system; willingness to work deeply in finance-system data flows.

  • Fluent in English and German, with the ability to collaborate confidently across Germany and the U.S.

  • A hands-on, detail-oriented, and proactive working style, with the resilience to operate effectively in a changing startup environment.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical accounting topics to non-finance stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.
